pages.text: Simply Swords unique weapons are the best weapons in the pack. They are $(bold)boss-drop-only$() — not craftable, not tradeable, not found in chests. Each is matched to a specific boss thematically.$(br2)$(bold)42 unique weapons$() exist across all 4 tiers. Drop chances range from 8% (rarest) to 25% (Ender Dragon's Waking Lichblade). On average, expect 6–8 kills to guarantee a drop.

pages.title: Tier 4 Uniques
pages.text: $(li)Ender Dragon: Waking Lichblade (25%)$(li)Ultimate Bosses: Mjolnir, Storm's Edge$(li)Deep Aether: Flamewind$(br2)$(bold)Build note:$() Unique weapons do not have an enchanting penalty — they can be enchanted normally via Apotheosis. Affix reforging also works. A late-game unique weapon with excellent affixes and level 5 enchants is the strongest possible item in the pack.
